name: Danzaburou-danuki
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Danzaburou-danuki, revered supernatural tanuki leader of Sado whose illusions obstructed night travellers.
ANATOMY: ONE realistic raccoon-dog tanuki, natural dark eye mask, TWO ears, TWO eyes, FOUR paws, ONE bushy tail. No clothes, no enlarged supernatural body. [danzaburou-danuki-c01,danzaburou-danuki-c03]
MOMENT: The tanuki springs sideways into the extreme foreground, stern mouth open in command, one paw stamping the narrow road. At this exact instant a WALL-LIKE ILLUSION suddenly appears ACROSS THE MIDDLE OF THE PATH directly behind him. One fully clothed adult traveller in the middle distance reels back, hand against this impossible obstruction, interrupted mid-stride.
POWER: Documented path obstruction and mirage. Show a transverse earthen wall only two metres long and taller than traveller, isolated in the MIDDLE of an otherwise open curving path, with abrupt vertical ends and no adjoining walls. The path is plainly visible BEFORE the wall and continues BEYOND its edges toward dark forest. At its far right end the wall is partially transparent and rippled like heat-haze, allowing the continued path to be faintly seen through. NO magical glow, no energy ribbons, no floating debris, no ground eruption; the wall is an illusion, not earth manipulation. [danzaburou-danuki-c04,danzaburou-danuki-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: camera at tanuki eye level just above path; tanuki very close fills lower and left 65%, clear impossible transverse obstruction and startled adult in upper right; natural animal size established by path leaves, no giant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber moonbreak, deep walnut shadows, strong fur rim light, ordinary cold night mist.
SURFACE: rough real tanuki fur, muddy road; wall sharp textured centre with heat-mirage indistinct edge.
SETTING: rural Sado night footpath near Aikawa. [danzaburou-danuki-c01,danzaburou-danuki-c08]
MOOD: awe-inspiring uncanny supernatural guardian actively closing a path, never ordinary calm wildlife portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, watermark; no extra limbs, heads, tails, horns; no borrowed film/game/anime design; no nudity, gore, aura, glowing eyes, neon or runes. Not a garden wall, not a retaining wall, not an animal just standing beside masonry.
depicted_variant: ONE realistic tanuki raccoon-dog head with dark eye mask, two eyes, two ears, four paws and bushy tail; no human clothes, no exaggerated anatomy.

visual_requirements.description: ONE realistic tanuki raccoon-dog head with dark eye mask, two eyes, two ears, four paws and bushy tail; no human clothes, no exaggerated anatomy.
Illusory isolated transverse wall obstructs path before startled traveller, heat-mirage edge makes illusion visible; no glow or earth manipulation.
A dark rural night footpath in Sado near Aikawa.

aura: Imposing action and documented attributes (danzaburou-danuki-c01,danzaburou-danuki-c03); effect basis danzaburou-danuki-c04,danzaburou-danuki-c06.
artistic_choices: Dark warm palette, close low camera and dramatic side-light are artistic choices, not additional source facts.
Effects confined to documented action; no generic aura. Human clothing chosen opaque where needed; no unsupported giant size.
Startled fully clothed adult traveller stages the documented obstruction; partial transparency is an editorial visual shorthand for c06 mirage. Camera at animal eye level establishes natural size.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Root rejected: ordinary raccoon dog before garden wall; intact wall far behind lacks visible sudden obstruction/illusion c04.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: active forward tanuki with snarling open mouth, natural eye mask, no extra anatomy. Isolated transverse wall now visibly blocks narrow path before recoiling adult, path continues beyond transparent rippled edge; this stages c04/c06 documented obstruction and mirage, without earth eruption. One dominant moon lights edge rather than body aura. Subject and active supernatural incident read at 200px; all seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + paw crops. One realistic raccoon-dog tanuki with a natural dark eye-mask, two ears, two natural (non-glowing) eyes, a snarling open mouth, four legs (front paw stamping the foreground, others planted/under the body — no extra limbs) and one bushy raised tail; no clothes or enlarged body (c01/c03). An isolated transverse wall-illusion crosses the middle of the footpath with abrupt ends, the path visible before it and continuing beyond, its far-right end rippled like heat-haze (the mirage edge); a fully-clothed traveller recoils with a hand against it, interrupted mid-stride (c04/c06). Natural animal size set by path leaves; moonlit Sado night footpath near Aikawa (c01/c08). No glow, ground-eruption, energy ribbons, text or aura. Uncanny guardian actively closing the path.
